detail.longDescription: EPICS, the control software behind particle accelerators and fusion experiments, had a CVSS 9.8 bug needing no credentials or user interaction. CISA published it yesterday with three others, all in network message parsing: two integer overflows, a length mismatch, a type confusion. Per The Register, an autonomous agent found them (Cipher, Causal Security). Fixed in EPICS Base 7.0.11. https://www. cisa.gov/news-events/ics-advis ories/icsa-26-300-01 # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # ICS
